title: Rick Explains Binary Search: 'It’s Like a Drunk Morty, But Faster!'
caption: Binary search made easy with Rick & Morty! #ProgrammingHumor #Algorithms

scenes.script: Morty, you ever search for something in a sorted list? Like, say, the best burrito recipe?
Uh, yeah, Rick! But it takes forever if I check one by one.
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png
scenes.web_image: person checking items one by one

scenes.script: Exactly, Morty! Binary search is like halving the problem each time. Start at both ends and check the middle.
So, if I’m looking for 'al pastor,' I just pick the middle option and compare?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: Bingo! If it’s not there, you toss the half where it can’t be and repeat. Like cutting out bad episodes of 'Morty’s World'!
Wait, but how do you code this? Do you just guess the middle index?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: Close! You start with L=-1, R=size of array. Then m = l + (r - l)/2. Avoid overflow like I avoid your grandpa’s lectures.
But what if the array is empty? Or the element isn’t there?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: Edge cases, Morty! Check when L+1 == R. If not found, L will be -1 or R will be out of bounds.
But what about finding the lower bound, like the first instance of 'al pastor'?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: Just adjust your bounds! When you find it, move left to include all earlier occurrences.
scenes.web_image: code for lower bound binary search

scenes.script: So, binary search is like a more organized version of my room?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: Exactly! Now go find that burrito, Morty. And remember: O(log n) time means it’s faster than me saying 'I told you so!'
